description: Returns the crystal for each placement's tropical degree after Costelloe's Complete Guide to Crystal Astrology (360 degrees, one crystal each, with page locators), the Sun's before/focus/after crystal sequence, and what each crystal is looked to for (Mercury for communication, Moon for emotions, Venus for relationships). Western tropical practice, separate from Jyotish; not a gemstone prescription.

place.description: Catalogue query or display label when explicit coordinates are supplied

timezone.description: Required IANA timezone when explicit coordinates are supplied, for example Asia/Kolkata

timezoneOffset.description: Optional fallback offset; derived from timezone and the requested local date when omitted

name: calculate_crystal_profile
title: Crystal astrology profile (Western, tropical)
